title: Second Epistle of John
context: These blocks come from the Second Epistle of John in the Westcott-Hort Greek New Testament: a very short Koine Greek letter from the Elder to the elect lady and her children, on love, obedience, and receiving teachers who deny that Jesus Christ came in the flesh, with the plain style and repeated key words of the Johannine letters. Some opening words are printed in capitals in this edition; interpret them by meaning. Keep repeated Johannine terms such as ἀλήθεια, ἀγάπη, and μένω consistent across the letter. Do not reproduce the wording of a particular English Bible.
